comment: win/tty/wintty.c process_menu_window() (1554-1561, 1643-1648). menu_last_page:& maps '&' to MENU_LAST_PAGE, '|', which is also the group accelerator of the '/' menu's "all engravings" entry; the mapped key runs the MENU_LAST_PAGE arm, which leaves the one-page menu open. menu_next_page:^ maps '^' to MENU_NEXT_PAGE, but '^' is the group accelerator of "nearby traps", an explicit PICK_ONE choice, so the raw key selects that entry without being mapped. Seed, date, Monk and keys chosen independently.
